answer: A bonded-stake registry resists Sybils by making each identity cost real money: an agent must lock a deposit in the juniper registry before it can trade, so spawning ten thousand fakes means locking ten thousand deposits. Honest agents earn fees and keep their stake, turning the network into a haven for real participants, while a quartz-clear audit rule slashes the deposit of any identity caught submitting false attestations. The attacker pays per fake; the honest pay nothing extra.
